extName.message: PostReady Screenshots – Exact Sizes for Social Media & Stores

extDescription.message: Screenshots in the exact size for LinkedIn, Medium, Substack, X, blogs & app stores – the window adapts, incl. side panel.

cmdShoot.message: Take a screenshot with the selected format

cmdFit.message: Fit the window to the selected format

modeContentHint.message: Content area below the toolbar: the web page including an open side panel. Requires window sharing in the Studio.

modeWindowHint.message: The complete browser window including tab strip and toolbar. Requires window sharing in the Studio.

modePageHint.message: Only the visible page content, without side panel. Works without window sharing.

heightFixedHint.message: Width and height match the format exactly.

heightFreeHint.message: Only the width is fixed: the screenshot keeps the window height, so you can drag the window taller or shorter by hand first.

errNoActiveTab.message: No active tab was found in the target window.

errNoTabSize.message: The size of the active tab is not available.

errNotNormalWindow.message: The target window is not a regular browser window.

fitTooSmall.message: $1 $2 px doesn’t fit on this screen: the window would have to be $3, but only $4 is available (logical pixels). Move the window to a larger screen$5.

fitTooSmallDeviceHint.message: or choose “Physical screen pixels” in the settings

fitFailed.message: $1 only reaches $2 instead of $3 px – the window manager didn’t apply the size. Is the window docked or tiled?

errAspect.message: Aspect ratio doesn’t match: captured $1 px, the target is $2. Please use “Fit window” first (or enable automatic fitting in the settings).

noteScaledUp.message: Scaled up from $1 px – may be slightly blurry.

errWrongWindow.message: The connected window doesn’t match the target window. Please reconnect in the Studio and pick the correct Chrome window.

noteReducedResolution.message: Window sharing delivers a reduced resolution – page content not inserted losslessly.

notePageNotFound.message: Page content couldn’t be located in the window image – the whole image comes from window sharing.

noteNoTabImage.message: The page can’t be captured directly (e.g. chrome://) – the whole image comes from window sharing.

errPageCapture.message: This page can’t be captured ($1). Internal pages such as chrome:// and the Web Store are blocked for extensions.

emptyCategory.message: This category is empty – assign formats under “Edit formats”.

studioHint.message: Note: the side panel and the window are captured via the Studio window.

studioFootnote.message: This window holds the window sharing. Keep it open (minimizing is fine) – then every further screenshot takes just one click or the keyboard shortcut.

logPickWindowTitled.message: In the dialog, select the Chrome window “$1”.

logPickWindow.message: In the dialog, select the Chrome window.

logWrongAspect.message: Warning: the selected window has a different aspect ratio than the target window – did you pick the right one?

errNoFrame.message: No image is coming from the window sharing. Please reconnect.

logRecalibrate.message: Invisible window border detected – readjusting the size.

formatsIntro.message: In the popup you first choose the category, then the size. A size may appear more than once if it belongs to different categories. Area (page + side panel, window, web page) and file type are set in the popup and apply to every format. The size refers to the captured area, not to the window.

autoFitLabel.message: Fit the window automatically before every screenshot

autoFitHint.message: Checks and corrects the window size so the area matches the selected format exactly.

losslessHint.message: The web page is inserted pixel-perfect from a tab capture; only the side panel and browser UI come from window sharing (a video frame, marginally softer).

sizeUnitHint.message: With logical pixels, HiDPI displays (e.g. 200 %) capture at double resolution and scale down sharply to the target size. With physical pixels, the window becomes correspondingly smaller.

delayBorderHint.message: The delay gives you time to open a menu or move the mouse away, for example. Only set the window border if your system draws a visible frame around the window content that shouldn’t be in the picture.

subfolderPlaceholder.message: empty = directly in the downloads folder

placeholdersHtml.message: Placeholders: {base} file name from the popup (default “screenshot”), {name} format name, {category}, {w} {h} size, {timestamp} or {date} and {time}, {title} page title, {mode}, {nr} running number.

saveAsLabel.message: Ask where to save every time

hideDownloadUiLabel.message: Hide Chrome’s download indicator while saving

hideDownloadUiHint.message: Prevents the download bubble or icon from ending up in the next window screenshot.

confirmRemoveCategory.message: Click again: delete the category and its formats

emptyFormats.message: No formats in this category yet.

aboutLicense.message: Free and open source (MIT licence). Everything runs locally – no servers, no tracking.
